title: Is Flow Matching Just Trajectory Replay for Sequential Data?
abstract: arXiv:2602.08318v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Flow matching (FM) is increasingly used in scientific domains for time series generation and forecasting, where data often arise from underlying dynamical systems. However, it is not well-understood whether it learns transferable dynamical structure or simply performs an effective ''trajectory replay''. We study this question by deriving the optimal velocity field targeted by the empirical FM objective on sequential data. For the Gaussian conditional paths commonly used in practice, we show that the resulting sampler is an ODE whose dynamics describe a nonparametric, memory-augmented continuous-time dynamical system. The driving velocity field admits a closed-form expression as a weighted mixture of instantaneous velocities determined by observed transitions. translated_title: 流匹配对于序列数据仅仅是轨迹重放吗？
translated_abstract: 流匹配在科学领域中被越来越多地用于时间序列的生成与预测，而这些数据往往源自底层的动力系统。然而，目前尚不清楚流匹配究竟是学习到了可迁移的动力学结构，还是仅仅执行了一种有效的“轨迹重放”。我们通过推导经验流匹配目标在序列数据上所对应的最优速度场来研究这一问题。对于实践中常用的高斯条件路径，我们证明由此得到的采样器是一个常微分方程（ODE），其动力学描述了一个非参数的、记忆增强的连续时间动力系统。该驱动速度场具有闭式表达式，即由观测到的状态转移所确定的瞬时速度的加权混合。这一刻画为神经流匹配模型提供了一种可解释的视角——将其视为对底层非参数目标的参数化估计——并自然引出了FreeFM：一种...
tldr: 本文推导了序列数据上流匹配目标的最优速度场，揭示其本质是一个非参数、记忆增强的连续时间动力系统，其速度场可表示为观测转移的瞬时速度的加权混合，为神经流匹配模型提供可解释视角并提出FreeFM。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the optimal velocity field targeted by the empirical flow matching objective on sequential data, revealing that FM acts as a nonparametric, memory-augmented continuous-time dynamical system whose velocity field is a closed-form weighted mixture of instantaneous velocities from observed transitions, providing an interpretable view and leading to the FreeFM method.
